command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# /tmp/.local/bin: where the offline user install puts `meson`, which numpy's f2py tests call by name.
export PATH=/tmp/.local/bin:/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl MPLBACKEND=Agg
# xdist's documented remedy for parametrizations that iterate a set (each worker hashes differently).
export PYTHONHASHSEED=0
cd /tmp
echo "== staged bytes must match their pins =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged check does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p wh && mv ./*.whl ./*.conda wh/ && (cd wh && sha256sum -c ../packages.sha256) \
  || { echo "FAIL: a staged package does not match its pin"; exit 1; }

echo "== pytest from the staged wheels, offline (the env ships no test runner) =="
python3 -m pip install -q --no-index --find-links wh --no-deps wh/*.whl 2>&1 | grep -v "not on PATH" | tail -2
python3 -c "import pytest, xdist, hypothesis, pytest_timeout; print('pytest', pytest.__version__, ' xdist', xdist.__version__, ' hypothesis', hypothesis.__version__)" \
  || { echo "FAIL: the test runner did not install from the staged wheels"; exit 1; }

echo "== a writable copy of the three packages, byte-identical, plus scipy's tests from its companion build =="
# The suites write beside their own test files, and site-packages is read-only to the image user.
SP=$(python3 -c "import numpy, os; print(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(numpy.__file__)))")
mkdir -p /tmp/sp /tmp/plug /tmp/scipy-tests && cp account.py /tmp/plug/
cp -a "$SP/numpy" "$SP/scipy" "$SP/pandas" /tmp/sp/
for p in numpy scipy pandas; do
  diff -r -q "$SP/$p" "/tmp/sp/$p" || { echo "FAIL: the copy of $p is not byte-identical"; exit 1; }
done
# conda-forge splits scipy's tests into `scipy-tests`, which pins this exact scipy build; the env lacks it.
python3 -u - <<'PYEOF' || { echo "FAIL: scipy-tests did not unpack"; exit 1; }
import glob, json, tarfile, zipfile
pkg = glob.glob("wh/scipy-tests-*.conda")[0]
with zipfile.ZipFile(pkg) as z:
    for n in z.namelist():
        if n.endswith(".tar.zst"):
            z.extract(n, "/tmp/scipy-tests")
info = glob.glob("/tmp/scipy-tests/info-*.tar.zst")[0]
with tarfile.open(info, "r:zst") as t:
    idx = json.load(t.extractfile("info/index.json"))
dep = [d for d in idx["depends"] if d.startswith("scipy ")][0]
import scipy, importlib.metadata as md
print("scipy-tests", idx["version"], idx["build"], "depends on", repr(dep))
installed = glob.glob("/opt/conda/conda-meta/scipy-1*.json")[0].rsplit("/", 1)[1][:-5]
want = "scipy-" + dep.split()[1] + "-" + dep.split()[2]
print("installed", installed, "| required", want)
assert installed == want, "scipy-tests was built for a different scipy build"
n = 0
with tarfile.open(glob.glob("/tmp/scipy-tests/pkg-*.tar.zst")[0], "r:zst") as t:
    for m in t.getmembers():
        pre = "lib/python3.14/site-packages/"
        assert m.name.startswith(pre), m.name
        m.name = m.name[len(pre):]
        if m.name.startswith("scipy_tests-1.18.1.dist-info/"):
            continue   # the test package's own metadata, not part of scipy
        assert m.name.startswith("scipy/"), m.name
        t.extract(m, "/tmp/sp", filter="data"); n += m.isfile()
print("unpacked", n, "files into /tmp/sp/scipy")
PYEOF
# Every difference from the installed scipy must be a file scipy-tests added -- nothing overwritten.
diff -r -q "$SP/scipy" /tmp/sp/scipy | grep -v "^Only in /tmp/sp/scipy" && { echo "FAIL: scipy-tests changed an installed scipy file"; exit 1; }
export PYTHONPATH=/tmp/sp:/tmp/plug
python3 -c "import numpy, scipy, pandas; [print(m.__name__, m.__version__, m.__file__) for m in (numpy, scipy, pandas)]; assert all(m.__file__.startswith('/tmp/sp/') for m in (numpy, scipy, pandas)), 'not the copy'" \
  || { echo "FAIL: the suites would not import the copy"; exit 1; }

echo "== BLAS: what the same digest selects on this host =="
python3 -u - > show.txt 2>&1 <<'PYEOF'
import ctypes, numpy, threadpoolctl
numpy.show_config()
for i in threadpoolctl.threadpool_info():
    print({k: str(v) for k, v in i.items()})
    if i.get("internal_api") == "openblas":
        try:
            lib = ctypes.CDLL(str(i.get("filepath")))
            lib.openblas_get_corename.restype = ctypes.c_char_p
            print("openblas_get_corename", lib.openblas_get_corename())
        except Exception as e:
            print("corename unavailable:", type(e).__name__)
PYEOF
cat show.txt
grep -q "filepath': '/opt/conda/lib/libopenblas" show.txt || { echo "FAIL: OpenBLAS did not load from the image"; exit 1; }

N=$(nproc)
run_group() {   # name, python code calling the project's own test entry point, then its pytest args
  local g=$1 code=$2; shift 2
  T0=$(date +%s)
  ACCOUNT_OUT=run-$g.json python3 -u -c "$code" "$@" -p account > suite-$g.log 2>&1
  echo "$? $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))" > rc-$g
  echo "group $g: exit/wall $(cat rc-$g)"
  grep -E "^(FAILED|ERROR) " suite-$g.log | head -40
  grep -E "[0-9]+ (passed|failed)" suite-$g.log | grep " in " | tail -1
}
collect() {   # name, python code, pytest args -- a SEPARATE serial --collect-only process
  local g=$1 code=$2; shift 2
  ACCOUNT_OUT=collect-$g.json python3 -u -c "$code" "$@" --collect-only -p account > collect-$g.log 2>&1
  echo "collect $g: exit $? -- $(grep -E 'tests? collected|collected [0-9]' collect-$g.log | tail -1)"
}

echo "== NumPy's own wheel test (tools/wheels/cibw_test_command.sh), with its CI's --timeout=600 =="
export NPY_AVAILABLE_MEM="4 GB"
NP="import sys, numpy; sys.exit(not numpy.test(label='full', extra_argv=sys.argv[1:]))"
collect   numpy "$NP"
run_group numpy "$NP" -n=$N --durations=10 --timeout=600 -rfEs

echo "== SciPy's own wheel test (scipy.test()), on $N workers, with its CI's --timeout=60 =="
SC="import sys, scipy; p = int(sys.argv[1]); sys.exit(not scipy.test(extra_argv=sys.argv[2:], parallel=p or None))"
collect   scipy "$SC" 0
run_group scipy "$SC" $N --durations=10 --timeout=60 -rfEs

echo "== pandas' own wheel test (pyproject [tool.cibuildwheel] test-command): parallel, then single_cpu serially =="
export PANDAS_CI=1
M="not clipboard and not slow and not network and not db"
PD="import sys, pandas as pd; pd.test(extra_args=sys.argv[1:])"
collect   pandas-all    "$PD" "-m $M" --no-strict-data-files -q
collect   pandas-par    "$PD" "-m $M and not single_cpu" --no-strict-data-files -q
collect   pandas-single "$PD" "-m $M and single_cpu" --no-strict-data-files -q
run_group pandas-par    "$PD" "-m $M and not single_cpu" "-n $N" --no-strict-data-files --timeout=600 -q -rfEs
run_group pandas-single "$PD" "-m $M and single_cpu" --no-strict-data-files --timeout=600 -q -rfEs

python3 -u suite_check.py numpy scipy pandas-par pandas-single 2>&1 | tee suite-summary.txt
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: a suite did not pass cleanly"; exit 1; }
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
